title: Tutoring Large Language Models to be Domain-adaptive, Precise, and Safe

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluation using the 'Cultural Kaleidoscope' dataset (15,000 queries) covering 11 global cultures and 12 sensitive topics via 'crescendo-based' multi-turn conversations to detect hidden biases, stereotypes, and violations of social norms/taboos.

Assessment of safety alignment and guardrail effectiveness across diverse languages (including low-resource languages like Bengali vs. high-resource ones) by measuring Attack Success Rates (ASR) and identifying language-specific functional parameters using the Soteria framework.
